definitions.avg_record_delay_mins: Arithmetic mean of supplied On_Time_Delay_Mins over booking records. Train-date values conflict, so this is not a verified punctuality measure.
definitions.avg_record_occupancy_pct: Arithmetic mean of Occupancy_Percentage across accepted booking records, equally weighted per booking. Not a measured train-service load factor.
definitions.booking_value_inr: Sum of source Total_Revenue_INR, renamed recorded booking value. Includes Confirmed, RAC, Waitlisted and Cancelled records. Refunds, settlement and recognized revenue are unavailable.
definitions.bookings: Count of accepted booking records; each accepted Booking_ID is unique.
definitions.cancellation_rate_pct: Cancelled accepted records divided by all accepted records. No status-history or refund data are available.
definitions.distinct_train_numbers: Count of distinct supplied Train_Number values; not trains operated or service departures. Numbers map to multiple names and routes.
definitions.lead_time: Travel_Date minus Booking_Date in calendar days. Negative values are retained and flagged; only nonnegative values enter valid lead-time means and medians.
definitions.monthly: Calendar month of Booking_Date, not Travel_Date or a recognized-revenue date.
definitions.passengers: Sum of Passenger_Count across retained booking records, including all statuses; not observed passengers carried.
definitions.population: One accepted booking ID per row, after exact-row deduplication and quarantine of every member of conflicting booking-ID groups. All statuses are retained.
definitions.route: Route labels and supplied station pair/distance/zone. No independent route validation or geocoding.
definitions.total_users: Distinct supplied User_ID values in the selected accepted booking population; not total registered platform users.
definitions.train_dimension: One row per train number with only consistent type and capacity attributes. Names/routes/zones are retained on facts or route dimension, never arbitrarily chosen for a train number.

findings.interpretation: Conflicting booking dates cannot be resolved from this file; all affected IDs are isolated before reporting.
findings.title: Identity validation prevents inflated totals

findings.interpretation: Booking-to-travel lead-time findings apply only to nonnegative records and should not be generalized to all bookings.
findings.title: Chronology limits planning analysis

findings.interpretation: Prioritize investigation of high-volume route experience within this sample; validate representative coverage before business action.
findings.title: Largest route by booking count

findings.interpretation: This is a descriptive channel mix. Conversion, marketing return and channel profitability require additional data.
findings.title: Largest booking channel

findings.interpretation: One year of booking records establishes a within-sample peak, not a recurring seasonal pattern.
findings.title: Peak month of recorded booking demand

findings.interpretation: Tatkal and Premium Tatkal are combined here. Value differences also reflect passenger counts, distance, class and train-type mix; no causal price effect is identified.
findings.title: Tatkal mix and recorded value

policies.chronology: Retain otherwise accepted rows with booking date after travel date for descriptive booking KPIs; flag and exclude only from valid lead-time analyses.
policies.conflicting_booking_ids: After exact-row deduplication, quarantine ALL rows whose Booking_ID has more than one distinct source record. No row is selected arbitrarily.
policies.exact_duplicates: Keep the first occurrence of an identical full source row; save removed occurrences with their source row numbers.
policies.financial_reconciliation: Require recorded booking value to equal base fare + surge/Tatkal + catering + taxes/convenience. Fail on mismatch and report count.
policies.missing_or_malformed: Fail immediately on missing required values, malformed dates/time/numbers, nonpositive passenger/capacity values, negative currency/delay/distance, occupancy outside 0-100, or changing source schema.
policies.operational_fields: Flag inconsistent train metadata and conflicting train-date occupancy/delay. Retain record-level descriptive values; do not infer service load, punctuality, utilization or actual operated trains.
policies.provenance: User-supplied educational dataset. No independent evidence that these are official IRCTC production records; findings apply only to this file.
